entities.summary: Church of Holy Trinity also known as St. Roch on the Golden Hill is a Roman Catholic church in Minsk. In the 1930s, the church was closed and the valuables removed by the Soviet authorities. Renovation of the church started in 1983. Church of Holy Trinity is a church building in Europe, established in 1864. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
